name: Flux-Pinnacle
geological_features: Towering mountain ranges with peaks exceeding 20 kilometers
Magnetic pole anomalies that shift position daily
specific_features: Spatial rifts appearing and disappearing at irregular intervals
Signal of unknown origin from the highest peak
description: Flux-Pinnacle is an airless rocky world of extreme vertical relief, its surface buckled into mountain ranges that reach staggering heights in the reduced gravity. The tallest peak, known to surveyors as the Needle, exceeds twenty kilometers and is visible as a hair-thin line from orbit. Between the mountains, plains of impact glass reflect the starlight with mirror-like perfection, creating a landscape that alternates between soaring darkness and blinding reflection.

Without atmosphere, the world exists in absolute silence and razor-sharp contrast. Shadows are pure black voids, sunlit surfaces are blinding white, and the transition between them is instantaneous. The magnetic anomalies create visible effects only through their impact on instruments and charged particles; compasses spin freely, navigation systems produce contradictory readings, and charged dust particles occasionally form ghostly aurora-like formations close to the surface where the magnetic flux is strongest.

The spatial rifts that manifest on Flux-Pinnacle are its most unsettling feature: brief tears in the fabric of space that open without warning, persist for seconds to hours, and close just as suddenly. Through them, observers have glimpsed landscapes that match no known world, starfields with unfamiliar constellations, and in one documented case, what appeared to be the interior of an artificial structure. A signal broadcasting from the Needle's summit was detected by the first survey mission and has been continuous since, its content defying all decryption attempts.

The spatial rifts make Flux-Pinnacle one of the most scientifically significant planets in the sector, but also one of the most dangerous to study. Equipment positioned near rift manifestation points has been lost through the openings, and one research drone returned after being absent for three minutes registering internal timestamps of four years. The dark crystal deposits and platinum veins are secondary concerns compared to the rifts, which may represent natural wormhole phenomena or something deliberately engineered.
